utme_subjects: Mathematics, Economics plus any Social Science subject.
olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Economics and any other two (2) subjects. For NBC holders, the other two (2) relevant subjects could be from any of Principles of Accounts, Commerce, Office Practice and Secretarial Duties.
direct_entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes chosen from Economics, Accounting, Business Management, Government and Geography.
